task: Design a Nature-first convergence evidence Figure from an explicitly labelled practice dataset.
claim: Across the supplied illustrative trajectories, objective values decrease over iterations, while the best-so-far view exposes transient regressions and endpoint improvement.

evidence_panels.source: observed objective and cumulative historical best
derived percentage decrease from first observation to final historical best

review_risks: Practice data must not be presented as a competition result.
The derived endpoint panel must not be interpreted as uncertainty or statistical significance.
The legend, panel labels, and practice-data note must remain readable at final size.
design_requirements: Use an asymmetric quantitative grid with panel a as the hero evidence.
Keep method colors consistent across both panels.
Use a quieter support panel and direct percentage annotations.
Show observed trajectories and historical-best trajectories without hiding regressions.
scientific_unknowns: No replicate runs, confidence intervals, or formal baseline comparison are supplied.
